**Chinese name:** 上海微电子装备（集团）股份有限公司 (Shànghǎi Wēi Diànzǐ Zhuāngbèi (Jítuán) Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's only domestic lithography scanner maker of consequence — the single most consequential equipment chokepoint firm in this tracker, since lithography (not etch or deposition) is the tool class export controls target hardest.
:::

## What does this firm supply?

Photolithography scanners (the SSA600 series, 90nm-class) and related mask-inspection tools.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Equipment |
| **Segment** | Lithography |
| **Node Capability** | 90nm-class confirmed in volume production (SSA600 scanner); a 28nm lithography claim surfaced via a shareholder social-media post in December 2023 but was later removed and is treated here as unverified |
| **Founded** | 2002 |
| **HQ** | Shanghai |
| **Entity List** | Yes — US Commerce BIS |
